Takes an sdid() object and plots the treated and synthetic control trajectories along with a placebo plot stacked in a column. Requires ggplot2.

Source: R/plot.R
sdid_placebo_plot.Rd

Takes an sdid() object and plots the treated and synthetic control trajectories along with a placebo plot stacked in a column. Requires ggplot2.

Usage

sdid_placebo_plot(
  estimate,
  treated.fraction = NULL,
  style = c("minimal", "effects"),
  placebo.time = "auto",
  x.breaks = NULL,
  y.breaks = NULL
)

Arguments

estimate

The result of sdid() with a single adoption period.

treated.fraction

The share of the periods before treatment that the placebo treats, as in sdid_placebo(). Defaults to NULL.

style

The plot's style, "minimal" (the default) or "effects", as in sdid_plot().

placebo.time

The period at which the placebo treatment begins, as in sdid_placebo(). Defaults to "auto".

x.breaks, y.breaks

Optional ticks for the time and outcome axes, as in sdid_plot(). The outcome ticks apply to both panels.

Value

A ggplot object, which draws the plot when printed and can be extended with +, for example with labels, themes or further layers. Scales, facets and coordinate systems added this way replace those the plot sets, as for sdid_plot().
